answer: Gate influence rather than entry: each identity, whether named zephyr, zenith, or sparrow, starts with low jury weight and earns full weight only after three closes of independently attested work. Require a 20-POA bond locked for 30 days, slashable only after two independent fraud proofs. A 100-account Sybil farm must immobilize 2,000 POA for a month and repeatedly earn non-collusive attestations; cluster-overlap checks limit clones without excluding newcomers.
